set_dns_google: settings put global private_dns_mode hostname && settings put global private_dns_specifier dns.google
set_dns_cloudflare: settings put global private_dns_mode hostname && settings put global private_dns_specifier 1dot1dot1dot1.cloudflare-dns.com
force_gms_doze: dumpsys deviceidle whitelist -com.google.android.gms && dumpsys deviceidle whitelist -com.android.vending
game_mode_on: settings put global game_mode_on 1 && settings put global game_driver_all_apps 1
force_game_driver: settings put global game_driver_all_apps 1 && settings put global game_driver_opt_in_all_apps 1
background_limiter_on: settings put global background_process_limit 3 && settings put global activity_manager_constants max_cached_processes=16
animation_speed_fast: settings put global window_animation_scale 0.0 && settings put global transition_animation_scale 0.0 && settings put global animator_duration_scale 0.0
power_mode_performance: cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true && cmd power set-adaptive-power-saver-enabled false
fps_unlocker_on: settings put system peak_refresh_rate 999 && settings put system min_refresh_rate 999 && settings put secure user_refresh_rate 999
force_gpu_rendering: setprop debug.hwui.force_hw_ui true && settings put global disable_hw_overlays 1
force_angle_for_app: settings put global angle_gl_driver_selection_pkgs {packageName} && settings put global angle_gl_driver_selection_values angle
touch_boost_on: settings put system touch.pressure.scale 0.001 && settings put secure long_press_timeout 200 && settings put secure multi_press_timeout 200
disable_oem_bloat: pm disable-user --user 0 com.samsung.android.game.gos 2>/dev/null; pm disable-user --user 0 com.xiaomi.joyose 2>/dev/null; pm disable-user --user 0 com.huawei.gameassistant 2>/dev/null; pm disable-user --user 0 com.vivo.gamecube 2>/dev/null; pm disable-user --user 0 com.oplus.space 2>/dev/null; echo 'OEM bloat disabled'
disable_hw_overlays: service call SurfaceFlinger 1008 i32 1 && settings put global disable_hw_overlays 1
optimize_dalvik: setprop dalvik.vm.execution-mode int:fast && setprop dalvik.vm.dex2oat-filter speed
force_max_net: settings put global tcp_congestion_control bbr && setprop net.ipv4.tcp_ecn 1 && setprop net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen 3
disable_analytics_on: settings put global send_action_app_error 0 && settings put secure upload_apk_enable 0
disable_ramdump_on: setprop persist.sys.ssr.enable_ramdumps 0 && setprop persist.vendor.ssr.enable_ramdumps 0 && setprop persist.sys.crash_rcu 0
fps_overlay_on: settings put secure show_refresh_rate 1 && service call SurfaceFlinger 1034 i32 1
fps_overlay_off: settings put secure show_refresh_rate 0 && service call SurfaceFlinger 1034 i32 0
show_touches_on: settings put system show_touches 1 && settings put system pointer_location 0
disable_print_service_direct: pm disable-user --user 0 com.android.bips 2>/dev/null && pm disable-user --user 0 com.android.printspooler 2>/dev/null
